svg.title: Spatial convergence of a supplied diffusion operator to an analytic solution
svg.desc: Panel a: the heat equation on the unit interval, with the sine initial condition, the exact solution at time 0.5, and open circles from a 16-interval finite-difference solution lying on the exact curve. Panel b: maximum error against the exact solution on log axes for five meshes, lying on a line of slope two.
